description: Fetch a single French public-contract award (DECP) by its unique record id (uid), as returned by fr_decp_search_contracts. Returns the full award record: buyer, supplier SIRET, amount, dates, CPV, procedure, duration, and geography for both parties.

uid.description: The DECP record uid from a fr_decp_search_contracts result, e.g. "217500016000192026F10374_32300000".

name: fr_decp_get_contract

category.description: Null when the buyer category (acheteur_categorie) is not published for this award.

data_as_of.description: The publisher's date for the file, never today's date; null with data_as_of_note when unreadable.

title: Fr Decp Get Contract
